name: The LUMA Hotel, Kota Kinabalu, a Member of Design Hotels
short_description: Borneo's first creative Design Hotels member, a boutique art-led property on Sutera Avenue in central Kota Kinabalu with a signature Sabahan-wood spiral staircase and street-level dining.
ai_summary: The LUMA Hotel is Kota Kinabalu's first creative design hotel, opened in January 2022 and enrolled in Marriott Bonvoy as a Design Hotels member. Occupying floors of a mixed-use office and apartment block on Sutera Avenue, it leans hard into design: a lobby spiral staircase built from local Sabahan wood inlaid with white marble, greenery, jewel-toned modular furniture, rotating local art and playlists by Sabahan musicians. Guestrooms carry nature-inspired names and a minimalist, earthy palette with wood panelling and raffia headboards. Independent reviewers and guests consistently praise the interior design, spotless rooms, silent and effective air-conditioning, warm attentive staff, and the convenient location a short covered walk from Imago Shopping Mall with cafes and restaurants at street level, including Flow Coffee by roaster Crack Inc. and JoJo Gastrobar. Watch-outs are real: because the hotel sits inside a larger building, several room categories lack proper windows or views; guests report the lobby-cafe breakfast is overpriced, Wi-Fi can be slow, and some note noise. As a Design Hotels affiliate, Bonvoy elite recognition is limited compared with full-service Marriott brands. Overall a stylish, well-located boutique stay best suited to design-minded short city trips rather than resort-style holidays.

faqs.question: Where is The LUMA Hotel located and how far is the airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel is on Sutera Avenue (Jalan Sembulan) in Kota Kinabalu's central business district, about a five-to-eight minute covered walk from Imago Shopping Mall. Kota Kinabalu International Airport (BKI) is roughly 7 km away, around a 10-minute drive depending on traffic.

faqs.question: Is The LUMA Hotel part of Marriott Bonvoy?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is a Member of Design Hotels bookable through Marriott Bonvoy, so members earn and redeem points. As a Design Hotels affiliate rather than a full Marriott brand, elite recognition and benefits are more limited than at standard Marriott properties.

faqs.question: What should I know about the rooms before booking?
faqs.answer: Rooms are minimalist and design-led with wood panelling, earthy tones and clean, quiet air-conditioning that guests praise. Because the hotel occupies part of a larger office and apartment building, some room categories have no window or view, so request a windowed room when you book.

reviews.title: Hotel Review 2022 - The LUMA Hotel, Kota Kinabalu, Sabah
reviews.author: Miera Nadhirah
reviews.summary: A design-focused walkthrough praising the waterfall-like spiral staircase, green rainforest-themed rooms, stylish bathrooms, in-house Flow Coffee and JoJo Gastrobar, and eco touches; only note is the gym not yet open at visit.
